"''Which is why it is crucial that our invasion of Geonosis meets with success.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Ki-Adi-Mundi|audio=NoEndInSight-LaPR.flac|}} The '''Second Battle of Geonosis''', also known as the '''invasion of Geonosis''' or '''second invasion of Geonosis''', took place in [[21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]], which had also served as the site of the conflict's [[First Battle of Geonosis|opening battle]]. The battle began when the [[Galactic Republic]] launched a full-scale planetary invasion of Geonosis in an attempt to cease the operation of several [[battle droid]] [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|factories]] constructed by the [[Geonosian]] [[Archduke]], [[Poggle the Lesser]]. Following a covert [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|mission]] conducted by [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to the planet [[Cato Neimoidia]], the Republic managed to discover that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had constructed a series of [[droid]] [[Factory|factories]] on Geonosis, which led to the dispatch of a large [[Jedi]]-led invasion force from the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] to retake the planet and hinder the production of more battle droids. Upon their arrival, the Jedi, tasked with forming a staging area for their assault, mounted a three-pronged attack on the Separatist forces under the command of [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker]], who each led their respective forces to the [[Point Rain|landing site]]. Following their establishment of the landing zone, the Republic forces recuperated and managed to breach the [[deflector shield]] protecting the droid factories, allowing for additional [[clone trooper]] reinforcements to arrive. Jedi General [[Luminara Unduli]] joined Anakin Skywalker for the final assault, staging a diversionary attack at the entrance to the foundry while [[Padawan|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee]] snuck inside the factory to destroy it from within. They succeeded, and the factory was demolished. Afterwards Unduli led the search for Poggle the Lesser, following him into the hive of [[Karina the Great]], where Poggle was captured. ==Prelude== {{Quote|This investment by the Banking Clan will create unimaginable new war profits. The largest droid factory ever built.''"
"''As long as the Republic doesn't find out.|Rush Clovis and Lott Dod conspire on investing in Poggle the Lesser's primary droid foundry|audio=NewWarProfits-SS.flac|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} The [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] suspected [[Rush Clovis]], [[Senator]] for [[Scipio]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]], was conspiring with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Thus, they asked Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to [[spy]] on Clovis, but she refused. However, she accepted the assignment when her secret [[Marriage|husband]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], convinced her to do this mission after he told her that he may be working with the Confederacy. [[File:Cato_foundry_holo.png|thumb|left|250px|Senators Clovis and Dod meet with Poggle the Lesser on Cato Neimoidia.]] Amidala was able to convince Clovis to let her accompany him on a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|trip]] to [[Cato Neimoidia]] to speak with the [[Neimoidian]]s. After arriving there, Amidala discovered that Clovis was working with Senator [[Lott Dod]] and [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]] in building the biggest [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|droid factory]] that would give them great profits. Poggle and Dod insisted they should get a greater share of the profits, but Clovis refused. Poggle and Dod then decided to [[poison]] Amidala to get Clovis to change the deal. Amidala then stole the [[hologram disc]] of the [[factory]] before succumbing to the effects of the poison. Skywalker, disguised as her [[pilot]], was able to get the disc and save Amidala when Clovis gave her the [[antidote]]. However, Skywalker left him behind without the disc. Following the [[engagement near Dorin]], the Republic sent [[Jedi General]]s [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Luminara Unduli]], and [[Anakin Skywalker]] to take [[Geonosis]] with a massive invasion. The [[Jedi]] [[General]]s then spoke with the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] Command about their plans for the coming battle. They would attack the [[Geonosis ray shield generator|shield generator]] protecting the [[Weapons factory|factory]] with a three-pronged assault. They hoped to capture Poggle who holed up at the factory. Despite [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] concerns, [[Jedi Master]]s [[Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu]] gave the go ahead for the attack, beginning what would amount to be a multi–[[Standard day|day]] battle.{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} ==The battle== ===Landing at Point Rain=== {{Quote|We've got no air cover. Two generals on the ground beyond our position. And a mess of bugs surrounding us. The enemy was more than prepared for our attack, sir. They knew our every move.''"
"''Well, I'm sure General Skywalker and General Mundi will make it to our position. We just have to make sure we're still here when they arrive.|Cody and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=StillHereWhenTheyArrive-LaPR.flac|}} [[File:GeonosisDifficultLanding.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The forces of the Republic suffered many casualties due to strong Geonosian resistance.]] As the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class transgalactic assault ships]] made their descent, Kenobi's and [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody]]'s force boarded their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i]] [[gunship]]s and flew to secure the [[Point Rain|rendezvous point]]. Despite the strafing runs performed by the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)|squadron]], the gunships came under heavy [[fire]] from [[Geonosian]] air and ground defenses. Mundi's and [[Commander]] [[Jet]]'s [[Jet's battalion|forces]] then followed. However, Mundi and Jet were forced to land their [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TEs]] away from the rendezvous point due to the underestimation of the Geonosian resistance. Simultaneously, Skywalker's, Commander [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s, and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]]'s gunships were shot down and all their AT-TEs were destroyed. Despite that, Skywalker, his [[Skywalker's team|team]], and the rest of his forces from the [[501st Legion]] continued towards the rendezvous point. Mundi's gunship was shot down and Mundi was wounded. Commander Cody was able to land his AT-TEs, but the landing area came under fire from the Geonosians and their [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|AATs]]. The [[212th Attack Battalion]] suffered heavy losses over the course of the battle.{{HelmetCollectionCite|35|Highlights of the Saga}} Kenobi's gunship was hit and crash landed away from the landing zone. Only Kenobi and [[clone trooper]] [[Trapper (clone trooper)|Trapper]] survived the crash, though the two had to be rescued by [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s [[Waxer]] and [[Boil]] of the 212th's [[Ghost Company]] after the gunship was spotted by the clones. Kenobi and Trapper were brought to Point Rain, and [[AT-TE 636]] gave covering fire for the group. Kenobi, Cody and their troopers then held the rendezvous awaiting Skywalker's and Mundi's forces. As Mundi's forces made their way through the [[Caltrop field]] to the rendezvous point, Jet contacted [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] for air support. The Admiral however, could not divert any air support with risks to other units. Despite that, Yularen gathered a [[squadron]] and put it in reserve. Jet then left a squad with the AT-TEs and went with Mundi and his [[clone flametrooper]]s to the rendezvous. They went into a [[cave]] that Mundi believed would be the quickest way to the rendezvous point. In the cave, they were then attacked by Geonosians, but were able to fight their way to the end the cavern. ===Securing Point Rain=== {{Dialogue|Tano|So, Master, what was your total?|Skywalker|Not now, Ahsoka.|Tano|Come on. Are you afraid you lost this time?|Skywalker|Fine. 55, that's my count. And you?|Tano|Sixty. Looks like I won.|Skywalker|Yeah, but I called in the air strike. Tie.|Tano|You're impossible.|Kenobi|I'll never understand how you can simplify these battles into some kind of game.|attr=Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker, and Obi-Wan Kenobi discuss the fighting at Point Rain|src=}} [[File:AhsokaAnakinVsDroidekas-LaPR.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Tano battled several droids at the top of the fortress before blowing it up so their troops could move forward.]] Skywalker's forces then made their way to the rendezvous point against the Geonosians and their gun emplacements. Skywalker and his force then came to a [[Eastern barrier|fortress]] that blocked their path. Skywalker and Tano then scaled the wall. They were able to destroy the [[battle droid]]s, but they were then confronted by [[droideka]]s. Skywalker and Tano were able to defeat the droidekas with Rex's help. They then planted explosives inside the wall and the way was cleared. Skywalker's forces were then able to meet up with Mundi's forces. Skywalker then contacted Yularen for air support. Yularen was able to provide a squadron of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]]/[[bomber]]s. [[File:SecondGeonosis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Republic reinforcements arrive at Point Rain]] As Kenobi's forces were being overrun, the bombers then took out the Geonosians' forces surrounding the rendezvous point. Skywalker's and Mundi's forces then joined Kenobi's to plan the last part of their attack. Skywalker would attack the outer defenses of the [[fortress]] while Kenobi brought in the AT-TEs and Mundi brought the gunships. Skywalker, Tano and a [[squad]] were able to penetrate the shield. They then threw [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade|droid poppers]] at the fortress's [[J-1 proton cannon|proton cannons]], disabling them. Kenobi then brought the AT-TEs in range of the [[Ray shield|shield]] [[Ray shield generator|generator]] and they destroyed it. After the shield went down, Mundi brought in the gunships and captured the remaining Geonosians. Kenobi and Mundi, along with the rest of their wounded, left to recuperate, leaving Skywalker, his [[Padawan|apprentice]], and their forces to destroy the factory. ===Destroying the factory=== {{Quote|How do we keep the Geonosians occupied while someone else is setting the bombs?''"
"''Good point, Snips. If whoever is going in there is going to be successful, we'll need to create a diversion.''"
"''Precisely. That task will be carried out by you and I, Skywalker, while the destruction of the factory falls to the Padawans.|Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker, and Luminara Unduli|}} To help Skywalker, Tano and their forces in destroying the factory, Unduli, along with her apprentice [[Barriss Offee]] and Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree's]] [[41st Elite Corps]] to assist in the attack. Skywalker originally planned for a frontal assault, but Unduli suggested that they infiltrate the factory using the [[Geonosian catacombs|catacombs]] under it and blow it from the inside. They agreed, despite Skywalker's concern, that Tano and Offee would carry out the infiltration while Unduli and Skywalker would distract Poggle's forces. [[File:2nd_Battle_of_Geonosis_2.png|thumb|right|250px|The forces of the Republic faced the droids and the Geonosians head-on to hold their attention.]] As Tano and Offee made their way through the catacombs, Unduli and Skywalker then marched their combined [[troop]]s organized into a [[battalion]] across the bridge, without cover to get Poggle's forces' attention. During his time there, Poggle and his [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]], [[TX-21]], were running the factory at 50% capacity and had ten [[garrison]]s of [[droid]]s ready to be deployed. The [[Separatist super-tank prototype|super tank]]s were not finished yet but would be ready. The droids were then deployed, marching across the bridge to fight the clones. As the two forces fought, TX-21 then sent in Geonosians to attack from above. Despite this, Skywalker's and Unduli's battalion were able to defeat the droids, including a [[squad]] of [[droideka]]s. However, Poggle, at the urging of TX-21, deployed a [[TX-21's super tank squadron|squadron]] of twelve super [[tank]]s. As they moved in on the clones, Skywalker ordered their [[AV-7 Anti-vehicle Artillery Cannon|artillery cannons]] to fire at it, to no effect. The super tanks rolled over the clones as they made their way across the bridge. [[File:AhsokaBarriss-WF.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee infiltrated the droid factory to blow up the reactor and the factory along with it.]] As the battle raged above, Offee and Tano were able to make their way through the catacombs to the main [[reactor]]. Unfortunately, Offee inadvertently [[Sleep|woke]] one of the Geonosians, who informed Poggle and TX-21 of this. After planting the bombs, Offee and Tano were then confronted by Poggle, TX-21, their Geonoisans and a super tank. Tano threw a charge onto the tank that failed to even dent the super tank, but destroyed TX-21 in the blast. Offee and Tano then fought the Geonosians to get their bombs back, but failed. When Tano was knocked out, Offee took the droid drivers and took control of the super tank. Both of them decided to use the tank to destroy the factory. As the super tanks moved across the bridge, Unduli and Skywalker planted explosives to make the tanks fall into the ravine. They were successful in destroying the tanks. However, they were then confronted by more [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]]. Skywalker then contacted Tano, telling her to set the bombs off. However, they then used the tank, knowing it might [[Death|kill]] them. They fired the tank at the reactor, and the factory collapsed, burying them inside the wreckage. Despite that, Skywalker and Unduli were able find their apprentices alive. ===Search for Poggle=== {{Quote|Anakin, the queen took Luminara hostage. She wanted a Jedi, now she has two more. I want to know what she's after.''"
"''Well, when this doesn't go as planned, which it won't, I'll be ready.''"
"''That is ''so'' reassuring.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|audio=SoReassuring-LoT.flac|}} [[File:JediEscapeKarina.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi captured Poggle and ended Karina's reign and life by making the ceiling fall on top of her, crushing her.]] Despite the high casualties to the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic forces]], Separatist forces fell to the Republic after the factory's destruction, although the battle was still considered to be ongoing''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' as Poggle had escaped and a clean-up operation to uproot remaining Separatist forces was carried out by Jedi Generals Kenobi and Unduli. They also launched a search for Poggle to capture him before he could make his escape. Luminara and clone trooper [[Buzz]] tracked Poggle to a location known as the [[Progate Temple]]. It was believed this was a mistake, as the temple had been severely damaged in the open phases of the Republic's campaign, but once inside they were unexpectedly attacked. Buzz was killed in the fighting and Luminara was then captured. After the [[sandstorm]], Kenobi, Skywalker, and Cody led a force of clones, including [[Gearshift]], to investigate. Heading into the catacombs, they encountered [[Zombie|reanimated Geonoisans]] and eventually encountered the Geonosian [[queen]], [[Karina the Great]]. She told Kenobi and Skywalker about her [[brain worm]]s, which would enable her to control the minds of three [[Force-sensitive]]s. However, using the clone trooper's lights to blind their enemies, the Republic forces managed to rescue Luminara and capture Poggle. Thanks to a cave-in the clones caused, Karina was killed. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The Republic must begin debriefing Poggle right away if we're to get useful intelligence from him.''"
"''Master, I suggest we let our Padawans handle the supply mission.|Luminara Unduli and Anakin Skywalker|audio=MustBeginDebriefing-BI.flac|}} [[File:TB-73.png|thumb|left|250px|After an arduous battle, the Republic took control of the planet and part of its troops left the world with new missions.]] Following the capture of Poggle, he was brought into Republic [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|custody]]. Some time later, the Archduke was transferred to a [[prison]] on [[Coruscant]] as a prisoner of war. There, he was repeatably [[Torture|interrogated]] about a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|secret superweapon]] some in the Republic thought the Separatists could be developing. The discovery of brain worms and their ability to control mind made [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] theorize that worms may have been important in the [[Occupation of Geonosis|reconquest]] of the planet by the [[Geonosian]]s, which consequently led to the Second Battle of Geonosis. The crew of a [[TB-73|Republic Pelta-class Medical Frigate]] leaving [[Geonosis]] were infected by [[brain worm]]s, but the [[Skirmish aboard TB-73|infestation]] was contained by [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who used the worms' vulnerability to low temperatures to kill them. Tano's actions made the incident end with few casualties. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So in the end, the Geonosian arc, what it really did in the bigger picture of ''The Clone Wars'' was it forced us to work on a scale we'd never worked on before. We did different types of episodes that ranged from massive action to almost horror-type episodes. We were dealing with new Jedi Knight Ki-Adi-Mundi. We were dealing with better effects in the flamethrower. We introduced the character of Poggle, we were dealing with more in-depth story arcs overall, so all in all Geonosis represents a landmark for us in ''The Clone Wars'', but it's just really now a shadow of the things that were to come.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]}} The Second Battle of Geonosis,{{SWE|characters|clone-commander-jet|Clone Commander Jet}} was a battle that was featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' . It was part of a five-part story arc. Three of the episodes that featured the actual battle were [[Landing at Point Rain]]," "[[Weapons Factory]]," and "[[Legacy of Terror]]," which began airing on [[November 4]], [[2009]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/landing-at-point-rain-episode-guide|text="Landing at Point Rain" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} and concluded on [[November 20]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/legacy-of-terror-episode-guide|text="Legacy of Terror" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} The three episodes were followed by the conclusion of the arc, "[[Brain Invaders]]," and were preceded by the episode "[[Senate Spy]]," which led into the battle by detailing the Republic's discovery of the droid foundries. The name "invasion of Geonosis" was given within "Landing at Point Rain" while its more formal name was first given within Clone Commander Jet's [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|online encyclopedia entry]]. ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' introduced the alternate name "second invasion of Geonosis."''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' The "Red Squadron Bomber" card given in ''[[BTL-B Y-Wing Expansion Pack]]'' misidentifies the battle as the first conflict for Geonosis by labeling it the "battle of Geonosis." ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} {{Flash}}
